behaviour: Every function of a module registered in ledger_core.EXTENSION_OPS that takes the op context names it by one Protocol, OpContext, which holds what an op reads and writes of one sync: at, rev, events, refused, meta, slug, dirty and stamps, and the calls author, record and stamp. A ctx left untyped, or typed Any, object or the concrete class, is refused, in a function and in a method alike, and so is a registered module in which no function takes the context. The one concrete context, ledger_core.Context, holds every member of the Protocol. A live check prints one line per registered module of the installed build and fails on the first of these that does not hold.
seam: scripts.swarm_ledger.op_context.OpContext against every function with a ctx parameter in the modules of scripts.swarm_ledger.ledger_core.EXTENSION_OPS, through scripts.feature_checks.op_context_typed
